sessionName: Week 9 - Portfolio founders and LP relationships
summary: George Berrington worked with James Whitlow and Sophie Archer on how Ashcombe looks after its existing relationships: portfolio founders and LPs. Happy founders and LPs are a source of referrals and the next fund. We agreed onboarding and advocacy steps for both.

discussion.keyPoints: James said the first 100 days after completion are inconsistent across platforms. One founder complained about reporting demands.
Ashcombe has 22 LPs; fundraise for Fund III is planned in 2028. Sophie noted LPs have asked for more detail on origination.
Only 2 deals in 5 years came from portfolio founder referrals.

recommendations.recommendation: Use a standard 100-day plan for every new platform with a single reporting pack template.
Ask every portfolio founder for two introductions to peers each year.
Assign each of the top 6 LPs a partner and give them a twice-yearly origination update.
Run an annual founder survey across portfolio companies, scored out of 10.

actions.action: Prepare the first LP origination update

nextFocus: Model the economics of the origination engine.
nextPreparation: Sophie to bring costs for the analyst, CRM, events and report.

tests.question: How many introductions are we asking portfolio founders for?
Is the top 6 LP update agreed?
What template did we agree for new platforms?
